record.one_liner: Notion is a connected workspace for notes, documents, wikis, and databases/projects.
record.auth_notes: Internal connection API token (static, per-workspace, created by a workspace owner) and personal access tokens (static, acts with the user's permissions), both sent as Authorization: Bearer with a Notion-Version header. OAuth 2.0 for public/scoped integrations (code exchange for access and refresh tokens).
record.access_notes: The docs name no plan requirement for the API. Internal tokens require a workspace owner to create the connection. OAuth public integrations need no marketplace review ("Marketplace submission or review is not required"). Free-plan API access is inferred from the absence of a plan requirement; it is not explicitly stated. Rate limit is 180 req/min per connection on non-Business/Enterprise plans, 600 req/min on Business/Enterprise. Data source queries are about 3 req/s. Whether PATs need admin approval is unclear.
record.blocker: Rate limits (180 req/min on lower plans, about 3 req/s for data source queries). Internal tokens require a workspace owner. Free-plan API access is not explicitly confirmed. The "broad" rating is based on the named resources (pages, databases, users, file uploads), not a full endpoint list.
